sentence.en: The Pace: 6.6% of papers in leading journals named AI methods in the 13 weeks to 9 Aug. That is up from 1.1% in 2015 to 2019, and up from 4.8% a year earlier. Clearly above the pre-AI level in 5 of 7 fields. Too few cases to judge in 1.
sentence.zh: 進度：截至 8 月 9 日的 13 週內，主要期刊有 6.6% 的論文提到 AI 方法，高於 2015 至 2019 年的 1.1%，也高於一年前的 4.8%。7 個領域中有 5 個明顯高於 AI 出現之前。有 1 個領域的案例太少，無法判斷。

text.en: An AI weather model forecasts ten days ahead.
text.zh: 一個 AI 天氣模型能預報未來十天的天氣。

text.en: An AI controller steadied a fusion test machine.
text.zh: AI 控制器讓一部核融合實驗機維持穩定。

big_picture.en: This is the first review in the sample record, so there is no earlier week to compare. No finding cleared our bar in the week before it. A quiet week is not evidence for or against the hope that AI is speeding up discovery. We would rather say so than pad this page. From here, each Monday looks back over the week: what changed in our understanding, what stood out, and what did not hold up. Some findings involve AI tools from companies that also help draft this site, such as Claude, and we mark each one when it does.
big_picture.zh: 這是範例紀錄中的第一次週回顧，沒有更早的一週可以比較。前一週沒有任何發現達到我們的門檻。平靜的一週，既不能證明也不能否定「AI 正在加快科學發現」這個期望。我們寧可直說，也不想硬湊內容。往後每個星期一，我們會回顧過去一週：我們的理解有什麼改變、哪些發現最突出，以及哪些沒有站得住腳。有些發現涉及也協助撰寫本站的公司所開發的 AI 工具，例如 Claude，我們會逐一標示。
